title: Cycle skeletoning and rollback fuel allocation playbook
creator: Nora Chen
description: Problem: Mid-cycle scope creep and emergency rollbacks repeatedly surface and cause multi-week disruptions and context-switching. We need a lightweight, repeatable playbook that defines a 'cycle skeleton' (the committed core) plus a quantified "rollback fuel" allocation (reserve staffing / buffer tickets) so teams can accept reasonable risk while protecting key SLAs. Goals: 1) Reduce mid-cycle unblock time by 30% for high-impact regressions; 2) Keep unplanned carryover < 8% of committed story points; 3) Make go/no-go and rollback decisions auditable and operationalized.
acceptance_criteria: A documented skeletoning checklist published in Confluence and linked from cycle kickoff templates
A standard ‘rollback fuel’ formula (percent of committed FTE / points) adopted by at least 3 product teams during Cycle 48
A surge pool created in Linear (3 templated rollback-fuel tickets per team) and visible in cross-team capacity dashboard
A retrospective showing at least 10% fewer emergency rollbacks vs previous cycle for pilot squads
Runbook includes owner, decision matrix, communication template, and tagged GitHub PR rollback playbook links
tasks: Draft playbook (PM) and workshop with Eng leads (due 2025-10-09)
Define rollback-fuel sizing heuristic (options: 10% FTE, 15% points, or 2 engineer-days per week) and simulate on last 4 cycles
Add three rollback-ticket templates to Linear with labels and required fields
Instrument cycle capacity dashboard to show committed vs skeleton vs rollback fuel allocation
Pilot with Search & Console squads in Cycle 48 and collect metrics
